evidence: Survives: every de Rham/Hodge-Tate conclusion in [F] (g9_hasHTWeights, g9_local, their TailC copies, g9_deRham in G9.lean) is for r : G_{Q_p} -> GL_2 with F/Q_p finite Galois; IsDeRham and htMult are defined only over Q_p, so arbitrary finite K/Q_l and non-Galois F/K are not covered. Both are conditional on DeRhamComparison and DeRhamComparisonWeights, and G9GlueHT is a Prop whose first premise is DeRhamComparisonHT, so the global forms are conditional as stated.

g9_hasHTWeights and g9_local take r : G_{Q_p} -> GL_2(C) and F finite Galois over Q_p, and fork's IsDeRham/htMult are defined only for G_{Q_p}; the only over-F predicate (IsDeRhamOver) appears in hypotheses (DeRhamComparison, LocalCore), never as a conclusion for r on G_K with general K, so the restriction K = Q_l, F/Q_l Galois is real. Weights uniform across coefficient embeddings for K = Q_l and the omitted continuity being forced are accurate, and the conditional hypotheses are as named.
